The '''scar serpent''' was a creature that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. When the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] awoke disoriented, figures in her field of vision swayed in a way that she likened to a scar serpent preparing to strike.<ref name="Into the Void" />
